## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Validation

List checks performed and their results. For camera tests, include only the
public model, firmware and features tested; distinguish real and synthetic media.

- [ ] No credentials, identifiers, private media or runtime data are included.
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility notes reflect the change, where applicable.
- [ ] Shared bridge changes preserve the compatibility add-on and update binary checksums, where applicable.
